capabilities: Highlight selected text with a color
Attach a comment to highlighted text
Filter, reply to and change the status of comments in a panel
Jump from a comment back to its place in the note
Serve comments over a local HTTP API so an AI can read and mark them done
extras: Desktop only; the local service listens on 127.0.0.1 and uses a token shown in settings. Interface is English by default with a Simplified Chinese option.
problem: Annotating a note normally means editing the note text, and there is no way for an AI agent to read or resolve those comments.

relations.evidence: Install the InkMark skill into common agent skill directories
Install the InkMark skill into common agent skill directories

summary: Underline-comment tool that keeps comments in the plugin data folder instead of the note, with an optional local HTTP API for AI agents.
